name: C-Media Electronics Inc.
summary: C-Media Electronics Inc., operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in the development, production, and sale of electronic components and integrated circuits. The company's reach extends across Taiwan, Mainland China, and international markets. Its product portfolio encompasses a variety of audio solutions, including USB audio codecs, controllers, and amplifiers, alongside general codecs and audio digital signal processing (DSP) technologies. Beyond these core offerings, C-Media also handles the import and export of electronic components, integrated circuits, and computer peripherals. The company provides information software services and is engaged in the manufacturing of optical instruments and lighting equipment. Furthermore, C-Media dedicates resources to hardware and software development, particularly for the technology, cultural, creative, and multimedia entertainment industries. Its activities also include general technology research and development, market operations, and the distribution of multimedia products such as MP3 and MP4 players. Established in 1991, C-Media Electronics Inc. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
